slots.notes: Fullscreen autoplaying muted looping hero background video, absolute inset-0 object-cover behind the H1/CTA stack.
About Us autoplaying muted looping inline video in the left 45% column, w-full h-auto rounded-sm.
Set of four 64x64 service-card icon images, object-contain, on the near-white inverted Services section (transparent background needed).
Inline hexagon logo glyph inside a 32x32 rounded bg-primary box in the navbar; the glyph is tinted by the primary green.

mechanic: A fixed-navbar dark landing whose sections fade-up (opacity+translateY) on entry, anchored by a fullscreen object-cover looping hero video with bottom-left headline/CTAs, then an inverted near-white 2x2 service-card grid and a black split video/text About section.
techDelivery: React + Tailwind CSS with HSL CSS custom properties and a custom animate-fade-up keyframe; Sora loaded from Google Fonts.
reskinNotes: Colors are declared as raw HSL triplets in Tailwind CSS custom properties (e.g. --primary: 119 99% 46%), so reskinning means editing those triplets, not hex; the Services section relies on foreground (0 0% 96%) being near-white to invert to a light background with text-background, so changing fg breaks that inversion. The navbar logo is an inline SVG hexagon tinted by --primary and must be swapped in markup. All copy (brand name, nav labels, headlines, the four service card titles/descriptions/numbers, About paragraph) is hardcoded in JSX. Headline uses an explicit line break after "Intelligent" and card titles use whitespace-pre-line with embedded \n, so copy length and break points are layout-load-bearing.
